seo.metaDescription: Losing someone to a preventable crash in Pinole is devastating. Our team helps families pursue wrongful death claims at no upfront cost.

hero.subtitle: When a fatal collision on I-80 or San Pablo Avenue takes someone from your family, the days that follow are overwhelming. Our team can help you understand your legal options and handle the work while you focus on each other.

about.title: Pinole Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Contra Costa County's public crash data shows Pinole recorded 68 injury collisions and 96 injured people in the most recent reporting year, with no reported traffic deaths logged in that same count — a reminder that most crashes here don't turn fatal, but when one does, the loss is total. Corridors like I-80, its eastbound and westbound stretches, and San Pablo Avenue carry heavy volume, and Wednesday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. see a noticeable spike in reported crashes. If a loved one died because of someone else's negligence on these roads or anywhere else in Pinole, California law gives certain family members the right to pursue a civil wrongful death claim, separate from any criminal proceeding. We handle wrongful death cases directly, offering a free consultation to explain your options, evaluate what happened, and walk you through next steps without any upfront cost.

whyChoose.title: What Pinole Families Should Know Before Moving Forward

items.title: Only Certain Family Members Can File
items.desc: California law limits wrongful death standing to a spouse, domestic partner, or children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in some situations. We can clarify who in your family qualifies to bring the claim.

items.title: The Clock Starts Running Quickly
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity was involved. Waiting even a few months can put important evidence and deadlines at risk.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond the Funeral Bill
items.desc: Recoverable damages can include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Our team can help identify all the losses that matter in your case.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California after a fatal crash in Pinole?
items.answer: State law generally gives priority to a surviving spouse, registered domestic partner, and children. If none of those exist, certain other dependents or heirs may be able to step forward. We can review your family's specific situation to determine who qualifies.

items.question: How long do we have to bring a claim if our loved one died in a crash on I-80 or San Pablo Avenue?
items.answer: In most cases, California gives you two years from the date of death to file a civil wrongful death lawsuit. That deadline can be much shorter if the crash involved a government-owned road or vehicle, which sometimes applies to busy corridors near Pinole. It's worth speaking with us early so nothing gets missed.

items.question: Is there any charge for us to contact you about our case?
items.answer: No. Our team works directly with families at no upfront cost. We typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless we recover money on your family's behalf.
